record.paper_title: Open problems for tractability of multivariate integration
record.original_question: For randomized integration in the weighted Sobolev Hilbert space on [0,1]^d with kernel product_{j=1}^d (1 + gamma_j min(x_j,t_j)) and positive nonincreasing weights gamma_j, is limsup_{d->infinity} (sum_{j=1}^d gamma_j^2)/ln d finite a necessary condition for tractability?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d\ge 1$ and let $\gamma=(\gamma_j)_{j\ge 1}$ be a sequence of positive nonincreasing weights. For each $d$ define the weighted Sobolev reproducing kernel Hilbert space $H_{d,\gamma}$ on $[0,1]^d$ as the tensor product Hilbert space with reproducing kernel
$$K_{d,\gamma}(x,t)=\prod_{j=1}^d\bigl(1+\gamma_j\min(x_j,t_j)\bigr),\qquad x,t\in[0,1]^d.$$
For $f\in H_{d,\gamma}$ consider the integration problem $I_d(f)=\int_{[0,1]^d} f(x)\,dx$. A randomized algorithm using $n$ function values is a measurable mapping $\omega\mapsto A_{n,\omega}$ where each $A_{n,\omega}(f)$ depends on $n$ values of $f$ at randomly chosen points and the random choice is independent of $f$. The randomized error is
$$e^{\mathrm{ran}}(n,d):=\inf_{A_n}\sup_{\|f\|_{H_{d,\gamma}}\le 1}\Bigl(\mathbb{E}\bigl|I_d(f)-A_n(f)\bigr|^2\Bigr)^{1/2},$$
and the randomized information complexity is $n^{\mathrm{ran}}(\varepsilon,d):=\min\{n: e^{\mathrm{ran}}(n,d)\le\varepsilon\}$. The integration problem is called tractable in the randomized setting if there exist constants $C,p,q\ge 0$ such that
$$n^{\mathrm{ran}}(\varepsilon,d)\le C\,\varepsilon^{-p}\,d^{q}\qquad\text{for all }\varepsilon\in(0,1),\ d\ge 1.$$

Question: Is the condition
$$\limsup_{d\to\infty}\frac{\sum_{j=1}^d \gamma_j^{\,2}}{\ln d}<\infty$$
necessary for tractability of randomized multivariate integration in the spaces $H_{d,\gamma}$?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search located the open-problem survey on tractability of multivariate integration where this question is posed as an open problem in the randomized setting for weighted Sobolev spaces, and located subsequent literature on randomized tractability for weighted Korobov/Sobolev spaces, but no source verifying that the necessity of the $\limsup_{d\to\infty}\sum_{j=1}^d\gamma_j^2/\ln d<\infty$ condition for randomized tractability has been settled. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.snippet: Open problems are presented for the tractability of multivariate integration in the randomized setting.
status_evidence.claim: The question is stated as an open problem about necessary conditions for randomized tractability in weighted Sobolev spaces.

status_evidence.title: Tractability of Multivariate Problems (Novak & Woźniakowski)
status_evidence.snippet: Necessary and sufficient conditions for tractability of multivariate integration in weighted Sobolev spaces; randomized setting discussed.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent monograph discusses randomized tractability for weighted Sobolev spaces but does not record this specific necessity as resolved.
